Job description

Software & Web Applications Developer

Shepherd’s Finance, LLC | Jacksonville, Florida
Full-Time | Entry Level / Early Career
Salary Range: $60,000–$70,000, depending on experience

About the Opportunity

Shepherd’s Finance is looking for a Software & Web Applications Developer to join our team in Jacksonville.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent college graduate or early-career developer who wants to do more than work on one small piece of a large application. You will have the opportunity to work directly with the people who use our systems, learn how a financial services company operates, and help build technology that will be used by our employees and customers.

You do not need years of professional experience. We are looking for someone with a solid technical foundation, strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

What You'll Work On

Your initial projects will include:

  • Improving our company website – Help modernize its appearance, navigation, usability, and functionality.
  • Building a customer portal – Help design and develop a secure online portal where customers can log in and access information about their loans.
  • Learning our internal loan system – Work alongside the developer of our existing Microsoft Access-based loan administration system to understand how it works and assist with future enhancements.
  • Developing new solutions – Help us identify ways to improve and automate business processes through better applications, reporting, and technology.

As you learn our business and systems, you will have the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility for application and web development.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Development, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent technical education and experience.
  • Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic programming and software development knowledge.
  • Understanding of databases and relational data.
  • Familiarity with SQL or database queries.
  • Exposure to web development.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar systems and technologies.
  • Good communication skills and attention to detail.

Professional programming experience is not required. Internships, school projects, personal projects, freelance work, and other demonstrated programming experience are all valuable.

Helpful — But Not Required

Experience or coursework involving any of the following is a plus:

  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • SQL and relational databases
  • C#, .NET, Python, or similar programming languages
  • Microsoft Access or VBA
  • Web application development
  • APIs
  • Microsoft Azure or other cloud platforms
  • Git or other source-control systems

Don't be discouraged if you don't know every technology on this list. We are looking for someone who has the fundamentals and is excited to learn.

About Shepherd’s Finance

Shepherd’s Finance is a Jacksonville-based financial services company specializing in residential construction lending. Technology plays an important role in how we manage our loan portfolio and serve our customers.

Because we are a smaller organization, this position offers the opportunity to work directly with experienced employees and company leadership, understand the business behind the software, and see the results of your work firsthand.

Benefits

Shepherd’s Finance offers a competitive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical insurance, company profit sharing, paid time off, a Trip Week benefit with a $1,800 vacation contribution, and a long-term employee anniversary bonus program.

Why This Role?

This position is a good fit for someone who enjoys figuring out how things work and wants broad, practical development experience early in their career.

Rather than being limited to one narrow programming function, you will gain experience with:

  • Web development
  • Databases
  • Business applications
  • Customer-facing software
  • Internal systems
  • Process automation
  • Financial technology

We are looking for someone who wants to learn, contribute, and grow with us.
